data.body_html:

This 2028 comparison cuts through the noise with concrete data: distances, pricing, fleet size, and what's included. Whether you're after a luxury yacht or a budget-friendly speedboat, our fleet departs exclusively from Puerto Banús, Marbella, and we'll show you why that matters.

Why Marbella's Puerto Banús Leads the Costa del Sol

Puerto Banús is the most famous marina on the Costa del Sol for a reason. It's the closest to the best anchorages: Cala del Faro (15 min), Cala Cortés (20 min), and Cabopino beach (25 min). Compare that to Estepona, where the first decent cove is 30-40 minutes away, or Sotogrande at 45 minutes. Marbella saves you time on the water, meaning more swimming, sunbathing, and sipping cava.

Fleet Size and Variety: Marbella vs Others

Our fleet includes 16 boats from 6.4m to 29m, accommodating 5 to 12 passengers. Estepona's charter market is smaller, with mostly 8-10m boats. Sotogrande has decent sailing catamarans (like the Lagoon 380) but few luxury motor yachts. Cabopino has only basic speedboats. Marbella offers everything from the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) for intimate trips to the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) for VIP experiences.

Pricing Breakdown: What You Get for Your Money

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, fully inclusive. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours with a free jet ski. Estepona might quote lower base rates, but often add fuel, crew, and taxes on top. Our prices include everything: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden costs.

If you're based in Marbella, you waste less time commuting to the marina. Our departures are from Puerto Banús, right in the action.

2028 Trends: All-Inclusive Charters Win

In 2028, travellers demand transparency. Our all-inclusive model means you don't worry about fuel surcharges or tipping the skipper. Estepona and Sotogrande still have many operators offering 'bareboat' or partial-inclusive deals. Our packages include soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks—everything for a perfect day on the water.

Scenic Highlights: Marbella's Unique Backdrop

Marbella offers the Golden Mile skyline, La Concha mountain views, and the glamour of Puerto Banús. Estepona has a charming old town but less dramatic coastal scenery. Sotogrande is flat and golf-centric. Cabopino is pretty but tiny. For Instagram-worthy shots and a vibrant atmosphere, Marbella wins.
